connectionStrings.name: AzureSqlDatabaseMicrosoftDataSqlClient
connectionStrings.connectionString: [format('Server=tcp:{0},1433;Database={1};Authentication=Active Directory Managed Identity;User Id={2};Encrypt=True;TrustServerCertificate=False;Connection Timeout=30;', reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Sql/servers', variables('sqlServerName')), '2023-08-01').fullyQualifiedDomainName, variables('sqlDatabaseName'), reference(resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', variables('webAppIdentityName')), '2024-11-30').clientId)]

protectedSettings.commandToExecute: [format('powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& ([scriptblock]::Create([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String(''{0}'')))) -ConfigurationBase64 ''{1}''"', variables('bootstrapScript'), base64(string(createObject('domainName', parameters('domainName'), 'netbiosName', parameters('netbiosName'), 'dsrmPassword', parameters('dsrmPassword')))))]
